css: .tb-h-glass-panel{position:relative;background:var(--tb-color-surface);color:var(--tb-color-text)}.tb-h-glass-panel__inner{max-width:var(--tb-h-glass-panel-width);margin:auto;padding:0 24px}.tb-h-glass-panel__brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--tb-color-secondary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:900}.tb-h-glass-panel__logo{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain}.tb-h-glass-panel__brand-name{letter-spacing:-.025em}.tb-h-glass-panel__nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tb-h-glass-panel__link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:9px 11px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:750}.tb-h-glass-panel__link:hover{color:var(--tb-color-primary)}.tb-h-glass-panel__parent{position:relative}.tb-h-glass-panel__submenu{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:100%;left:0;min-width:190px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--tb-color-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--tb-color-surface);display:none;box-shadow:0 16px 38px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 14%,transparent)}.tb-h-glass-panel__submenu .tb-h-glass-panel__link{display:flex}.tb-h-glass-panel__parent:hover>.tb-h-glass-panel__submenu,.tb-h-glass-panel__parent:focus-within>.tb-h-glass-panel__submenu{display:grid}.tb-h-glass-panel__chevron{font-size:10px;opacity:.65}.tb-h-glass-panel{padding:18px 0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-primary) 5%,var(--tb-color-background))}.tb-h-glass-panel__glass{min-height:70px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-border) 75%,transparent);border-radius:20px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-surface) 78%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;box-shadow:0 18px 44px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tb-color-secondary) 10%,transparent)}.tb-h-glass-panel__nav{margin-left:auto}.tb-h-glass-panel__cta{padding:10px 15px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:850}@media(max-width:820px){.tb-h-glass-panel__row,.tb-h-glass-panel__top,.tb-h-glass-panel__glass,.tb-h-glass-panel__frame,.tb-h-glass-panel__pill{flex-wrap:wrap;height:auto;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:14px}.tb-h-glass-panel__nav{width:100%;order:5}.tb-h-glass-panel__submenu{position:static;box-shadow:none}}@media(max-width:560px){.tb-h-glass-panel__inner{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.tb-h-glass-panel__row{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.tb-h-glass-panel__search{width:100%!important}}
name: Glass Panel Header
description: A translucent floating header panel with soft borders and backdrop blur.
